---
title: "Study 2B: Parameter recovery of the best-fitting model (Model 1-4)"
output: html_document
date: "2023-11-30"
---

Parameter recovery for the best-fitting model (Model 1-4). The model is re-fitted
to the data simulated during the posterior predictive check (the `pred_mean`
column of `..._Rating_pred_orig_mean.csv`, produced by stan_model_2B.Rmd), and the
recovered individual-level parameters are correlated with the original estimates.

Output: Figure S7D -> FigureS7D_parameter_recovery.png

The recovery fit is cached: if `<model>_hbmrecovery.RData` exists it is reused.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r directories}
# Root directory of the Study_2B submission folder.
# Update this path if you place the folder elsewhere.
rootdir         <- "D:/DJ/JEPG/Study_2B"
data_savedir    <- paste0(rootdir, "/data/merged_prep_data/")
code_savedir    <- paste0(rootdir, "/code/")
stanfit_savedir <- paste0(rootdir, "/output/stanfits/")
plot_savedir    <- paste0(rootdir, "/output/figures/")

# Sources rstan/loo/tidyverse and the recovery-specific DJ_rstan_fit (which reads
# the simulated ratings from the `pred_mean` column)
source(paste0(code_savedir, "recovery_rstan_fit_2B.R"))

nIter   <- 3000
nwarmup <- 2000
nChains <- 4

models  <- c("DJ_2b_rescale_m1-4")
modelno <- length(models)

myconfig <- theme(
  axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 17, vjust = -1, face = "bold"),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 17, vjust = 1, face = "bold"),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.spacing = unit("0.5", "cm"),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 20, vjust = 3, hjust = 0.5),
  plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm"))
```

# 1. Re-fit the best model to simulated data (cached)

```{r recovery-fit}
df <- read_csv(paste0(stanfit_savedir, "DJ_2b_rescale_m1-4_Rating_pred_orig_mean.csv"))

for (m in 1:modelno) {
  model_tmp <- paste0(models[m], "_hbm")
  # The recovery fit is saved as "<modelStr>recovery.RData" with modelStr ending
  # in "_hbm" (see recovery_rstan_fit_2B.R), i.e. "<model>_hbmrecovery.RData".
  fitname   <- paste0(model_tmp, "recovery.RData")

  if (!file.exists(paste0(stanfit_savedir, fitname))) {
    print(paste0(model_tmp, " is now being fitted ..."))
    DJ_rstan_fit(modelStr = model_tmp, test = F, saveFit = T,
                 nIter = nIter, nwarmup = nwarmup,
                 data_dir = data_savedir, code_dir = code_savedir,
                 savedir = stanfit_savedir)
  } else {
    print(paste0(model_tmp, " has been fitted ..."))
  }
}
```

# 2. Extract recovered parameters and compare with original estimates

```{r extract-recovered}
m_win    <- 1
winmodel <- models[m_win]
fitname  <- paste0(stanfit_savedir, winmodel, "_hbmrecovery.RData")

pars_win     <- create_pois(paste0(winmodel, "_hbm"))
N_group_pars <- sum(stringr::str_detect(pars_win, "mu_"))
ind_pars     <- pars_win[1:(length(pars_win) - 4 - N_group_pars)]

fit <- readRDS(fitname)

get_pm_individual <- function(df_input, pars_input, df_input1, N_Chains) {
  Sbj_label <- unique(df_input1$participant)
  pars_value_all <- get_posterior_mean(df_input$fit, pars = pars_input)[, N_Chains + 1]
  data.frame(pars_value = pars_value_all,
             pars_name  = rep(pars_input, each = length(Sbj_label)),
             SbjIdx     = rep(Sbj_label, times = length(pars_input)))
}

# Recovered estimates (from simulated ratings)
pr_individual <- get_pm_individual(fit, ind_pars, df, nChains) %>%
  rename(pr_pars_value = pars_value)

# Original estimates (from observed ratings; produced by stan_model_2B.Rmd)
pm_individual <- read_csv(paste0(stanfit_savedir, "winmodel_", winmodel, "_indpm.csv"))

pr_recovery <- merge(pr_individual, pm_individual) %>%
  filter(pars_name != "sig")
pr_recovery$pars_name <- as.factor(pr_recovery$pars_name)
```

# 3. Figure S7D: true vs recovered parameters

```{r figure-S8B}
recovery_4plot <- pr_recovery %>%
  mutate(pars_name = recode(pars_name,
                            gamma_help   = "γ_compensation",
                            k_help       = "κ_compensation",
                            gamma_punish = "γ_punishment",
                            k_punish     = "κ_punishment")) %>%
  filter(!pars_name %in% c("w1", "w0"))

# Per-parameter Pearson correlation (true vs recovered)
df_r <- recovery_4plot %>%
  group_by(pars_name) %>%
  summarise(r = cor(pars_value, pr_pars_value, method = "pearson"), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("r = ", round(r, 2)), xpos = -1 + 0.05, ypos = 1 - 0.05)
print(df_r)

pr <- ggplot(recovery_4plot, aes(x = pars_value, y = pr_pars_value)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = .5, color = "gray50") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, size = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5)) +
  facet_wrap(~pars_name, scales = "fixed") +
  labs(x = "\nActual", y = "Recovered\n") +
  geom_text(data = df_r, aes(x = xpos, y = ypos, label = label), size = 5,
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, vjust = 1) +
  theme_bw() + myconfig +
  theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

ggsave(paste0(plot_savedir, "FigureS7D_parameter_recovery.png"), plot = pr,
       width = 7, height = 5)
```
